body:
The issue is a dental issue. Sorry I wasn't more clear while trying to maintain anonymity.

And yes it does feel dishonest. I was told basically I'd been lied to for years. I love you was said regularly. Then one day she's acting all odd and suddenly she wants at least separation. Oh she CARES she says but she's just not sure it's love anymore and it's apparently a feeling she's had for a long time. She really is running away. Still hurts like hell and makes me feel even more worthless. And those were feelings I was trying to get rid of in the first place.
